flashcards.q: Matrix and action of the Hadamard gate?
What does CNOT do in matrix terms?
flashcards.a: 4x4 permutation matrix swapping amplitudes of |10> and |11>: flips target iff control is 1.
CZ = diag(1,1,1,-1) = H(target) . CNOT . H(target); symmetric in control/target, native on many superconducting devices.
Exactly 3 CNOTs: CNOT(a,b) CNOT(b,a) CNOT(a,b). A distant CNOT over distance k edges costs ~3(2k-1) physical two-qubit gates after routing.

flashcards.q: Why is Toffoli called reversible AND?
flashcards.a: CCNOT maps |a,b,c> -> |a,b,c XOR (a AND b)>: computes AND into the target while remaining invertible; inputs recoverable from outputs. Optimal synthesis: 6 CNOT + 7 T gates.

flashcards.q: Definition of a universal gate set.
flashcards.a: Finite set G such that any n-qubit unitary can be approximated within any epsilon > 0 (operator norm, up to global phase) by products of gates from G.

flashcards.q: Canonical universal set and the non-universal one?
flashcards.a: {H, T, CNOT} is universal. {H, S, CNOT} (Cliffords) is NOT: finite group, dense approximation impossible, Gottesman-Knill makes it classically simulable.
Any single-qubit gate has an epsilon-approximation with O(log^c(1/epsilon)) gates from a fixed finite universal set closed under inverses; c ~ 3.97 originally, improved to ~3.68.
Rz, SX (sqrt-X), CZ or ECR depending on generation, plus measurement. H and CNOT are synthesised from these by the transpiler.

flashcards.q: Three jobs of a quantum transpiler?
flashcards.a: Basis translation to native gates, routing (SWAP insertion for coupling-map compliance), optimisation (gate cancellation, rotation merging, block resynthesis).

flashcards.q: Which cost metric dominates fault-tolerant resource estimates and why?
flashcards.a: T-count/T-depth: Clifford gates run transversally cheap in surface codes while T gates need magic-state distillation factories that dominate footprint and runtime.

A control qubit in superposition measuring controlled-U's eigenvalue e^{i phi} acquires the phase itself ((|0>+e^{i phi}|1>)/sqrt(2)), leaving the eigenvector target unchanged; basis for CZ synthesis and QEC syndrome extraction.

flashcards.q: NISQ success probability formula from depth?
flashcards.a: Approximately exp(-p2 * d_2Q - p1 * d_1Q) with per-gate error p2 ~ 1e-3; exponential decay in two-qubit depth is why transpiler-level 2Q-count reduction directly raises fidelity.
